report.summary: Index 'app-278-events-n8c3v6q1' has four mapped fields: app (keyword), lvl (keyword), ts (date) and txt (text). The level field is named 'lvl' (not 'level'), and the time field is 'ts' (the index has no @timestamp), so any search must be given time_field=ts. Using those actual names, a term query on lvl="ERROR" over 2026-10-25T00:00:00Z to 2026-11-23T18:14:00Z matched exactly 9 documents. A terms aggregation on lvl over the same window shows 27 documents total split as INFO 12, ERROR 9, WARN 6, with sum_other_doc_count 0, so ERROR is present only under the exact uppercase value and no other case variant was observed in that window. Sample ERROR documents carry app=billing-278 and messages such as 'payment gateway timeout 9' with ts='2026-11-23T18:10:09Z'. The index-level docs.count is also 27, matching the in-window total.
